value.message: Seattle University Kids Swim Lessons are for ages 3+, Jan 11 to Feb 11, Mon-Thu 4:30 or 5:00pm - their site says. YMCA of Greater Seattle's Swim Basics (ages 3 to 5) and Ballard Pool's preschool lessons are options too, but I could not get into their pages for winter days or prices. I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
